notes: Hard. The agent must combine lookup (instruments gain table, unit factor table), parsing (multi-file JSON catalogs with many malformed-record shapes that must be skipped without crashing), descriptor normalization (value * unit_factor * gain, rounded to 6 dp), inclusive-tolerance filtering against a target, and proximity ranking (score = 1 - distance/tolerance, ascending distance with obs_id tie-break), plus a mandatory normalization-reporting string per record. The verifier executes the deliverable program on the visible fixture and on three hidden scenarios: an inclusive boundary case (distance exactly at tolerance kept, just outside dropped), an adversarial mix (unknown units/instruments, non-string ids, booleans, non-object records, a distance tie broken by obs_id, mixed unit conversions), and a zero-match case yielding []. Rubric nonzero for adversarial_inputs, quantitative_correctness (exact rounded floats, exact sort, exact reporting strings), reasoning_depth (multi-stage normalization math), and hidden_case_generalization. No resource or interaction pressure.
